comment.body:
Thanks for attaching the report. The current logs show a shortcut-description exception, but that call is already handled in code, so the next useful evidence is the exact freeze trigger. Please provide:

1. Short numbered steps for the exact PowerToys Run query or selected result that causes the lag or freeze, including the text you typed.
2. The exact PowerToys version currently installed and whether the same freeze still happens on the latest stable build.

That will tell us which plugin/query path needs investigation instead of assuming the logged ShellLinkHelper warning is the whole issue.

design_decision.reason: Waiting on a more specific reporter reproduction.

confidence.rationale: Diagnostics show an anomaly, but the visible freeze trigger is still unknown.
